notes.title: Update 5.2.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a local multiplayer which means you can now play this game using remote play or test how the game works by playing against yourself
[*]You can now view the last turn even after a player has resigned
[*]Fixed being able to softlock the game using the knight
[*]Fixed the queen and the king being in the wrong positions
[*]Made it so that you now move the king on top of the rook to castle
[*]Fixed some missing localizations and improved existing ones
[*]Moved the player avatar on top of the nametag to make more space for the captured pieces
[*]Added a failsafe to prevent a bug where the names wouldn't be displayed
[/list]

notes.title: Update 5.0.0 and 4 years as game developer anniversary
notes.content:
[list]
[h1] DISCOUNT [/h1]
[*] To celebrate me being a game developer since 4 years the game is now 86% off for the next week

[h2] Bot [/h2]
[*] Optimized the Bot so the FPS dont drop when it is calculating its move and also improved how quickly it does the calculations while mainaining the same quality of the moves it does
[*] Made it so that the bot now responds to certain events like a piece getting captured with a small comment in a text bubble like on chess.com
[*] Exposed the bot vs bot feature. You can now watch two dumb bots play against each other
[*] Added back the difficulty setting for the bot.

[h2] User Interface [/h2]
[*] Added glyphs for when you use a gamepad in the UI during a match that change depending on the gamepad
[*] Added UI to display your name and avatar as well as the enemy's name and avatar

[h2] Other [/h2]
[*] Added a replay feature. You can now watch yourself loose as many times as you want
[*] Added shadows to the pieces and the board
[*] Added more options in the settings menu
[*] Added basic discord rich presence
[*] Polished the UI  in both the main menu and the match
[*] Added Portuguese Localization

[h2] Bug Fixes [/h2]
[*] Fixed an issue with the SFX Volume setting not affecting the UI Sounds
[*] Fixed an issue with the gamepad controls in the match where it was possible to at the same time rewind and place a piece
[*] Fixed an issue with the gamepad controls in the match where two cursors appeared at the same time
[/list]
